spec: SPEC-06-availability-monitoring.md section 3 (After hand-off); VERIFICATION 8b.4 (runbook for the owner updated); G6 6.6 (no {{...}} left)
summary: Added .github/workflows/uptime.yml (schedule '4,19,34,49 * * * *' + workflow_dispatch, 7 checks against the fixed base https://www.growmax.io, one retry each, content markers verified live, optional alert only when secrets.ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is set). The check script, extracted from the YAML and run from the container, passed all 7 against the live www; both negative tests exited 1 with clear FAIL lines; the alert payload was proven against a 127.0.0.1 listener only. Rendered docs/migration/CUTOVER-RUNBOOK.md post-cutover with 0 placeholders. Nothing committed; no database touched; no real webhook posted.

changes.what: rewritten as the rendered post-cutover runbook (TEMPLATE banner removed; status table; Step C from B-APEX; rollback with the Replit 404 caveat; content-freeze end; PR link; new 'Monitoring after the merge' section)

decisions.cron: 4,19,34,49 * * * * (15-minute cadence offset from :00 to avoid GitHub top-of-hour congestion)
decisions.retry: explicit loop, exactly 2 attempts per check, 5 s apart; a transfer error, non-200 or a missing marker each trigger the one retry (curl --retry would not retry a 404 or a marker miss)
decisions.compressed: curl --compressed added: /api/blog is 2,322,293 bytes raw and about 549,983 bytes brotli (x-vercel-cache HIT, so no function invocation); about 96 runs/day
decisions.redirects: curl does not follow redirects, so a redirect instead of a 200 fails the check
decisions.postSlug: first slug of /api/blog via jq, validated against ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ before building the URL; if /api/blog fails, blog-post fails with 'no usable slug'
decisions.alertInputs: failed check names reach the alert step through env (steps.checks.outputs.failed -> FAILED_CHECKS); the run URL is built from GITHUB_SERVER_URL/GITHUB_REPOSITORY/GITHUB_RUN_ID; the webhook URL is used only as a curl argument inside the script, never echoed; only the HTTP status is printed

checks.name: YAML parses (python3 yaml.safe_load)
checks.actual: parsed; name Uptime; on = schedule + workflow_dispatch (PyYAML 6.0.1; node not used: no YAML parser in the repo tooling)

checks.name: triggers
checks.expected: schedule (15-minute cadence) + workflow_dispatch only; no push/pull_request/pull_request_target

checks.name: job hardening
checks.expected: permissions contents: read; concurrency group; timeout-minutes 10 (above the worst-case runtime: 7 checks x (20 s + 5 s sleep + 20 s) = 315 s, plus the alert step up to 20 s = 335 s); runs-on ubuntu-latest; no actions/checkout or third-party actions
checks.actual: permissions {contents: read}; concurrency {group: uptime, cancel-in-progress: false}; timeout-minutes 10 (600 s > 335 s worst case; the arithmetic is in the ASCII comment directly above it); ubuntu-latest; 2 steps, both plain run, no 'uses'

checks.name: fixed base, no interpolation into scripts
checks.expected: BASE fixed; no ${{ }} inside run blocks
checks.actual: BASE='https://www.growmax.io'; ${{ }} appears only in env: (secrets.ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL at job level, steps.checks.outputs.failed at step level)

checks.name: content markers verified live (2026-09-27T10:2xZ)
checks.expected: each marker present on the live www
checks.actual: / title 'Growmax | B2B Revenue Ops for Manufacturers'; /blog title contains Growmax; /demo title 'Book a Demo | ... | Growmax'; sitemap has <urlset and <loc>https://www.growmax.io/</loc>; robots has 'Sitemap: https://www.growmax.io/sitemap.xml'; /api/blog JSON array of 172, all with slug; first slug claude-commerce-agents-b2b, post title contains Growmax and canonical https://www.growmax.io/blog/claude-commerce-agents-b2b

checks.actual: run1 at 10:36:09Z: home FAIL after 2 container-proxy errors (curl 28 timeout, then curl 35 reset), 6 PASS, exit 1 (environment, recorded); re-run once at 10:37:57Z: 7/7 PASS (api-blog passed on its retry after a proxy reset), exit 0. An earlier run of the pre---compressed version at 10:33:46Z was also 7/7 PASS.

checks.expected: non-zero exit with clear FAIL lines
checks.actual: TITLE_RE changed to NoSuchMarkerXyz: FAIL home, blog, demo, blog-post ('content marker not found: ...'); sitemap/robots/api-blog PASS; 'RESULT: 4 check(s) failed: home blog demo blog-post'; exit 1; GITHUB_OUTPUT got failed=home blog demo blog-post

checks.name: negative: nonexistent path
checks.expected: non-zero exit with clear FAIL line

(expected HTTP 200, got ...)'; other 6 PASS; 'RESULT: 1 check(s) failed: demo'; exit 1. The pre-final run at 10:34:30Z showed HTTP 404 on both attempts.

checks.name: all checks run after a failure
checks.actual: in both negative tests every later check printed its own PASS/FAIL line

checks.name: alert payload shape (127.0.0.1 listener only)
checks.expected: POST JSON {"text": ...} naming failed checks and the run URL; webhook URL not printed
checks.actual: listener received Content-Type application/json; charset=UTF-8, body keys ['text'], text 'Growmax uptime check failed: demo. Run: https://github.com/growmax/growmax-website/actions/runs/1234567890'; step log only 'Alert posted (HTTP 200)'; 0 occurrences of the listener URL in the log

checks.name: runbook content
checks.expected: TEMPLATE banner removed; header with deployment, SHA hSha, A2 wording; status table; Step C from B-APEX with current and new apex values; optional second www A; rollback with Replit caveat and SPEC-07; TLS window kept; PR link; freeze end; monitoring section
checks.actual: all present; SHA dc5405357441870b9315a28a7cbb93a201278453 = STATE.facts.git.hSha; cert dates from P8.1-dns-tls-sandbox.json; no ACME values

changes.what: timeout-minutes 5 -> 10, with a one-line ASCII comment above it giving the worst-case arithmetic
changes.why: if every URL hangs, each of the 7 checks takes up to 20 s + 5 s sleep + 20 s = 45 s (315 s total) plus the alert step up to 20 s; 5 minutes (300 s) would let GitHub cancel the run before it fails or alerts, so the monitor would stay silent in exactly that outage

changes.what: Status table Step A row: 'valid 2026-09-27T07:54:47Z to 2026-12-26T07:54:46Z' -> 'valid until 2026-12-26T07:54:46Z; Vercel renews it automatically'
changes.why: the certificate start time is back-dated by Let's Encrypt and reads as earlier than the DNS switch, which would confuse the owner

changes.what: 'Who gets told.' paragraph: appended two sentences saying GitHub emails one account only (possibly whoever merged the PR) and to add the chat alert if more people should hear or delivery is uncertain
changes.why: wording gap: the owner might assume the failure email reaches them or several people

changes.what: job-hardening check, decisions.concurrency and changes[0].sha256 updated for timeout-minutes 10; fixRounds added; checkedAt updated
changes.why: keep the evidence consistent with the files
